name: test-assistent-mcp-server
description: MCP server for OpenCode that exposes classic test techniques (BVA, EP, pairwise, decision table, state transition, use case, error guessing), test heuristics (SFDPOT, FEW HICCUPPS, RCRCRC, quality criteria, bug heuristics, test tours), and property-based test data generation (boundary, random, seed) as 8 tools.
long_description:
A knowledge-based MCP server for OpenCode agents that provides:

- **catalog_techniques**: list all classic test techniques
- **catalog_heuristics**: list all test heuristics
- **generate_test_cases**: generate concrete testcases for BVA, EP, and pairwise testing
- **generate_with_property**: property-based test data with boundary discovery and seed reproducibility
- **generate_boundary_cases**: automatic BVA for int, float, string, date types
- **generate_random**: constrained random data generation with optional seed
- **advise_technique**: keyword-based recommendation of techniques and heuristics
- **checklist_for**: produce a test checklist for a given context

The knowledge base (7 techniques + 6 heuristics) is bundled as JSON and loaded at startup.

tools.name: catalog_techniques
tools.description: List all classic test techniques (BVA, equivalence partitioning, decision table, pairwise, state transition, use case, error guessing).

tools.name: catalog_heuristics
tools.description: List all test heuristics (SFDPOT, FEW HICCUPPS, RCRCRC, quality criteria catalog, bug heuristics, test tours).

tools.name: generate_test_cases
tools.description: Generate concrete testcases for supported techniques (Boundary Value Analysis, Equivalence Partitioning, Pairwise Testing). Returns only testcases; the agent applies them.

technique.description: The technique name: 'Boundary Value Analysis', 'Equivalence Partitioning', or 'Pairwise Testing'

inputs.description: Technique-specific inputs, e.g. {field: 'age', min: 0, max: 150} for BVA

tools.name: advise_technique
tools.description: Recommend techniques and heuristics for a described testing context via keyword analysis.

description.description: Free-text description of the testing context or problem

tools.name: checklist_for
tools.description: Produce a recommended test checklist (items) for a context, e.g. RCRCRC for regression after a bug fix.

context.description: The testing context, e.g. 'regression', 'exploratory testing', 'no specification'

tools.name: generate_with_property
tools.description: Property-based test data generation. Defines a field with type, constraints, and count, returns test cases including boundary values and random data.

spec.description: Property spec: {field, type, constraints: {min, max, ...}, count, seed}

tools.name: generate_boundary_cases
tools.description: Generate boundary value test cases for a field. Supports int, float, string, date types with automatic edge case discovery.

tools.name: generate_random
tools.description: Generate constrained random test data for multiple fields with optional seed for reproducibility.

spec.description: Random spec: {fields: [{field, type, constraints}], count, seed}
